feedback.end: An aircraft is a vehicle that flies in the air.

instruction.text: Which type of aircraft is older?

text: The first successful flight was with a hot air balloon, in 1783. It used heated gas to lift a balloon with a basket underneath it.

atoms.b: Aircrafts called Zeppelins had big ((++balloons footballs)) but only small cabins. This meant that tickets were very ((++expensive comfortable)).
The first ever aeroplane ((++flight flaunt)) was performed by the Wright brothers in 1903. It lasted 12 seconds, using a ((++plane plant)) called the “Wright Flyer”.

instruction.text: Match the modern aircraft with its correct name.

feedback.correct: Airliners are the most common form of plane for travel. These large, jet-powered planes are filled with seats for passengers.
Seaplanes have propellers and floats on the bottom to allow them to land on water. They are often used for rescues at sea.
Helicopters have big rotor blades that allow them to stay still in the air. This is called hovering.
